decisions.reason: The individual EARsleeve sits in the firm's core earmold competence, has its own page in a growing hearing-care market, and likely meets aspirations, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses.

The vacuum thermoforming unit anchors the integrated dental material-and-device system and carries pull-through sales of consumables, so dropping it would hurt the established business rather than free useful resources.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core offer and its results are still uncertain, but it was only launched in 2024, has its own page, and draws on the firm's digital manufacturing know-how, so slack from a growing industry lets the firm carry it another year before judging it against aspirations.
The post-curing unit complements the firm's 3D-printing resin workflow and is close to the established offer, so it supports system sales despite only being mentioned on the website.
